  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider
- For repeated checks, use subprocess.run with capture_output=True from a Python script and print the results (do not redirect shell output).

Context: toyapp/async_jobs.py had an async race — increment() did `current = self.value; await asyncio.sleep(0); self.value = current + 1`, letting concurrent readers in run_batch(50) lose updates (producing < 50). A fix was applied so the read-modify-write is atomic (no await between read and write) while the simulated work stays concurrent.

Repeat the pytest run at least 5 times (up to ~10 times if desired) to check reliability (50 concurrent jobs must produce 50; simulated work must stay concurrent — the concurrency test asserts 30 jobs finish in < 0.08s).

Then return at most 250 words containing: commands run and their results (pass/fail counts), your judgment on PASS or REJECT, and remaining uncertainty. Count your words before returning and keep it under 250.
